blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly paired with knowledge graphs (KGs), yet end-to-end KG question answering conflates graph access, search, navigation, reasoning, and answer generation.
This coupling makes it difficult both to determine whether an SLM can faithfully execute the reasoning path implied by a question and to attribute failures to navigation rather than to other stages of the pipeline.
We isolate this capability by employing the THESEUS navigation and traceability framework and using frozen, off-the-shelf SLMs as local action policies.
At each hop, the environment exposes the legal outgoing graph actions, and the model selects one executable graph action and decides whether to stop, without task-specific parameter updates, model-controlled beam search, or free-form answer generation.
This controlled setting allows us to evaluate terminal-answer accuracy with Hits@1 together with path fidelity, using Path Edit Distance (PED) as the primary trajectory metric.
Across the Kinship and MQuAKE-ST KGQAs, similarly sized local models differ substantially in answer accuracy and path fidelity, with the two metrics sometimes favoring different models.
This model-dependent behavior also extends to prompting, as a single demonstrated trajectory can improve or degrade navigation depending on the model.
These results motivate evaluating SLM graph reasoning beyond endpoint accuracy alone.
blocks.zh:
小语言模型(SLMS)越来越多地与知识图(KGs)对齐,然而端到端的KG问题解答缩合图访问,搜索,导航,推理,和答案生成.
这种结合使得难以确定可持续土地管理是否能够忠实地执行问题所隐含的推理路径,也难以将失败归因于导航而不是管道的其他阶段。
我们利用THESEUS的导航和可追踪性框架,并利用冻结的现成可持续土地管理作为地方行动政策,孤立这种能力。
在每次跳动时,环境都会暴露出合法的外传图动作,模型会选择一个可执行的图动作,并决定是在没有特定任务参数更新,模型控制的光束搜索,或者自由格式的答案生成的情况下停止.
这种可控设置使我们能够用 Hits@1 与路径忠贞性一起评价终端答题的准确性,使用路径编辑距离(PED)作为主轨迹度量.
在整个Kinship和MQuake-ST KGQAs中,同样大小的本地模型在答案准确度和路径忠诚度上差别很大,两个度量衡有时倾向于不同的模型.
这种依赖模型的行为也延伸到了提示,因为单一的演示轨迹可以根据模型改善或降解导航.
这些结果促使评价可持续土地管理图表的推理超越了终点的准确性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide explicit relational structure for multi-hop question answering, and recent language-model systems exploit this structure through graph retrieval, path search, planning, and grounded answer generation [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
These systems demonstrate the value of graph scaffolding, but they make it difficult to determine whether a language model can choose the correct next graph action when search and answer synthesis are factored out.
This distinction is especially important for small language models (SLMs), where graph exploration has been identified as a major bottleneck inside a Think-on-Graph-style pipeline [ 4 ] .
Meanwhile, recent work on compact KG agents has focused on improving performance through task-specific training rather than evaluating navigation ability of frozen models [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh:
知识图(KGs)为多跳题解答提供了明确的关系结构,最近的语言模型系统通过图检索,路径搜索,规划,以及基础解答生成[1,2,3]来利用这一结构.
这些系统证明了图脚手架的价值,但是在将搜索和答题合成算出时,很难确定一个语言模型是否能够选择正确的下一个图动作.
这种区分对于小语言模型(SLMS)尤为重要,在小语言模型中,图解探索被确定为一个"思考-Graph"式管道中的一个主要瓶颈[4].
与此同时,最近关于紧凑型KG代理的工作侧重于通过针对具体任务的训练来提高性能,而不是评价冷冻型号的导航能力[5,6,7].

blocks.en:
We study this question within the THESEUS formulation of multi-hop KGQA as question-conditioned graph navigation [ 8 ] , where the executed KG path is evaluated together with the terminal answer.
Our focus is a deliberately restricted setting: Can an off-the-shelf SLM faithfully execute a multi-hop reasoning path when the environment exposes the legal local graph actions and the model is responsible only for selecting the next executable action and deciding whether to stop? Isolating this capability reveals whether navigation failures arise from the model’s local question-conditioned decisions rather than from retrieval, search, or answer synthesis, and provides a controlled baseline for measuring the value of additional reasoning mechanisms.
The controller fixes graph access, executes only legal edges, and uses the terminal entity as the answer, removing model-controlled candidate retrieval, pruning, beam/tree search, and free-form answer generation from the decision loop.
Related work has studied search-assisted KG reasoning and broader sequential graph navigation [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] , whereas our setting isolates local executable graph-action selection and termination within path-annotated multi-hop KGQA.
blocks.zh:
我们在多跳 KGQA 的 THESEUS 配方中研究这个问题,作为问题有条件的图导航 [8],其中执行的 KG 路径与终端答案一起评估.
我们的焦点是刻意限制: 当环境暴露了当地的法律图表行动,而模型只负责选择下一个可执行的行动和决定是否停止时,现成的可持续土地管理能否忠实地执行多跳推理路径? 孤立这种能力可以发现导航故障是否源于模型的局部问题决定,而不是来自检索、搜索或回答综合,并为衡量额外推理机制的价值提供了一个可控基准。
控制器会修正图访问,只执行法律边缘,并以终端实体作为答案,删除模型控制的候选检索,推算,束/树搜索,以及从决定循环中自由格式的答案生成.
相关工作研究了搜索辅助的 KG 推理和更广泛的顺序图导航[9, 10, 11],而我们的设置则将本地可执行的图形动作选择和终止隔离在路径附加说明的多跳 KGQA 中.

blocks.en:
Answer accuracy alone does not establish path fidelity: a model may reach a valid answer through a trajectory that differs substantially from the reference reasoning path [ 2 , 12 , 3 ] .
We therefore evaluate both ordered trajectory agreement, using Path Edit Distance (PED) over graph edges and order-invariant structural overlap, using F ​ 1 SG F1_{\mathrm{SG}} over traversed edges [ 8 ] .
PED serves as our primary trajectory metric.
We compare locally deployable SLMs under matched zero-shot and one-shot conditions on Kinship and MQuAKE-ST , finding that endpoint correctness and path fidelity can favor different models and that the effect of a single demonstrated trajectory is strongly model-dependent.
blocks.zh:
单是答案准确性并不能确定路径的忠诚性:一个模型可能通过一个与参考推理路径[2,12,3]大相径庭的轨迹得到有效的答案.
因此,我们使用图边上的路径编辑距离(PED)和图边的顺序变化性结构重叠,使用F 1 SG F1QQMTHRM{SGXQQQQ)在横贯的边缘上对命令的轨迹协议进行评估[8].
PED是我们的主要轨迹衡量标准。
我们比较Kinship和MQuAKE-ST上对应的零射和一射条件下的当地可部署的可持续土地管理,发现端点正确性和路径忠诚性可以有利于不同的模式,单一显示的轨迹的效果非常依赖模型。

blocks.en:
Contribution. We provide a controlled empirical characterization of the local multi-hop graph-navigation ability of frozen, locally deployable SLMs under the THESEUS navigation and traceability framework, separating terminal-answer correctness from executed-path fidelity and examining the effect of a single inference-time demonstration.
As a secondary analysis, we use this controlled baseline in a compact ToG-style comparison on MQuAKE-ST to examine how explicit search and answer-generation scaffolding affect terminal accuracy and trajectory fidelity.
blocks.zh:
贡献。 我们在THESEUS导航和可追踪性框架下,对冻结的、可在当地部署的可持续土地管理的当地多跳图导航能力提供了一种可控的实证特征,将终端答案正确性与执行路径忠诚性区分开来,并审查单一推论时间演示的效果。
作为次要分析,我们在MQuAKE-ST的紧凑的ToG风格比较中使用这一可控基线,以审查明确的搜索和答案生成脚手架如何影响终端精度和轨迹的忠实性。

blocks.en: 2 Task Formulation and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2 任务拟订和评价

blocks.en:
We build on the THESEUS formulation of multi-hop KGQA as question-conditioned graph navigation [ 8 ] .
Let a knowledge graph be 𝒢 = ( ℰ , ℛ , 𝒯 ) \mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{E},\mathcal{R},\mathcal{T}) , where ℰ \mathcal{E} is the entity set, ℛ \mathcal{R} is the relation set, and 𝒯 ⊆ ℰ × ℛ × ℰ \mathcal{T}\subseteq\mathcal{E}\times\mathcal{R}\times\mathcal{E} is the set of directed triplets.
Given a natural-language question q q , a known topic entity e s e_{s} , and a valid answer set 𝒜 ⁡ ( q ) ⊆ ℰ \mathcal{A}(q)\subseteq\mathcal{E} , the task is to execute a path P = ( e 0 = e s , r 1 , e 1 , … , r k , e k ) P=(e_{0}=e_{s},r_{1},e_{1},\ldots,r_{k},e_{k}) (1) such that every ( e i − 1 , r i , e i ) ∈ 𝒯 (e_{i-1},r_{i},e_{i})\in\mathcal{T} and the terminal entity e k ∈ 𝒜 ⁡ ( q ) e_{k}\in\mathcal{A}(q) .
As in THESEUS, the underlying reasoning length is not supplied to the agent.
Instead, questions are evaluated under a fixed maximum reasoning horizon N N .
At step t t , the legal outgoing graph-action set is 𝒩 ⁡ ( e t ) = { ( r , e ′ ) : ( e t , r , e ′ ) ∈ 𝒯 } . \mathcal{N}(e_{t})=\{(r,e^{\prime}):(e_{t},r,e^{\prime})\in\mathcal{T}\}. (2) For our SLM instantiation, the presented graph actions are assigned local identifiers, and the model outputs a pair ( i t , z t ) (i_{t},z_{t}) comprising a graph-action ID i t i_{t} (or null) and a stop flag z t z_{t} .
If i t i_{t} identifies a legal graph action, the controller deterministically executes the corresponding KG transition and appends the traversed triplet to the predicted path P ^ ​ ( q ) \hat{P}(q) .
If z t z_{t} indicates stopping, the episode terminates after the selected transition.
When i t i_{t} is null, the episode instead terminates at the current entity, and the null choice is valid only when stopping.
Otherwise, navigation continues until the maximum reasoning horizon N N is reached.
The terminal entity is returned as the predicted answer.

blocks.en:
Our SLM policy produces a single trajectory rather than a ranked rollout set.
We therefore measure terminal-answer correctness with Hits@1, where the terminal entity must belong to 𝒜 ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{A}(q) .
Because no ranked candidate set is produced, MRR is not defined in our evaluation.
For multi answer, reaching any valid answer counts as success.
For path fidelity, we follow the THESEUS evaluation protocol [ 8 ] .
PED is the Levenshtein distance between the ordered predicted and reference edge sequences, while F ​ 1 SG F1_{\mathrm{SG}} measures their order-invariant edge overlap.
Together, these metrics capture complementary aspects of trajectory fidelity: ordered path agreement and order-invariant edge overlap.
PED is our primary trajectory metric, with lower values indicating closer agreement and PED = 0 =0 corresponding to an exact reference-path match.
Together with Hits@1, these metrics provide a controlled measure of intrinsic local navigation against which additional search or task-specific adaptation can be evaluated.

由于没有编制排名排行榜,因此在我们的评价中没有定义MRR.

关于路径忠贞,我们遵循"TheSEUS评价协议"[8].

这些衡量标准合在一起,捕捉了轨迹忠贞的互补方面:有序路径协议和顺序-不定边重叠.

与 Hits@1 一起,这些度量衡提供了内在局部导航的可控度量,可以据此评价额外的搜索或任务特定的适应.

blocks.en:
For the local-navigation experiments, all SLMs are evaluated under
the same navigation interface defined in Sec. 2 .
At each step, the model observes the question q q , topic entity e s e_{s} , current entity e t e_{t} , executed path history, and the presented legal outgoing graph actions.
We use tuple graph-action selection over ( e t , r , e ′ ) (e_{t},r,e^{\prime}) , with all models receiving the same indexed triplet representation of presented actions and the same structured response schema— {action: ID/null, stop: flag} .
Models are evaluated off the shelf with frozen parameters.
Optional model-specific thinking or reasoning modes are disabled to avoid introducing additional inference-time token and compute budgets as a confound.
Each navigation decision uses a single model generation, with no parse-retry or repair calls.

blocks.en:
Our primary one-shot condition provides one complete solved trajectory from the training split as an in-context demonstration, showing the navigation state, available actions, and gold decision at each hop.
The zero-shot condition removes this demonstration while leaving the remaining navigation interface unchanged.
We use deterministic decoding with temperature zero, seed 42 42 , and a maximum response length of 64 tokens.
Code and evaluation scripts are publicly available. 1 1 1 https://github.com/HalcyonSolutions/LLM_KGQA

零射击条件在保留剩余导航界面不变的同时删除此演示.

We use action-display caps of 100 for Kinship and 200 for MQuAKE-ST .
For MQuAKE-ST , we evaluate two settings: Single Answer (SA) and Multi Answer (MA).

blocks.en:
ToG-style search. To quantify the effect of explicit search, we additionally evaluate the three strongest models on MQuAKE-ST SA using a ToG-style scaffold [ 1 ] .
We preserve the same directed KG and maximum horizon N = 4 N=4 , restricting traversal to legal outgoing edges.
The scaffold adds LLM-guided relation and entity pruning, global retention of w w candidate paths, accumulated-evidence sufficiency checking, and free-form answer generation.
These runs use the original ToG prompt templates rather than the structured zero- and one-shot navigation prompts used above.
We evaluate w ∈ { 1 , 3 } w\in\{1,3\} : w = 1 w=1 provides a single-retained-path condition closest to our local-navigation setting, while w = 3 w=3 follows the default ToG search width [ 1 ] .
We report terminal-answer Hits@1, generated-answer accuracy, PED of the highest-ranked retained path, and mean LLM calls per question (Calls/Q).

blocks.en:
Structural Calibration. Table 2 reports one-shot navigation performance together with the structural calibration references.
The unbiased random walk represents unguided traversal, while the shortest-path oracle is given the valid answer set but not the annotated reasoning path and selects a shortest route to an answer.
The oracle is therefore not a bound on path fidelity, since the shortest route to a valid answer need not coincide with the reasoning path implied by the question.
Models with lower edit distances and higher overlap scores than the oracle follow the annotated reasoning structure more closely than can be achieved from answer knowledge and shortest-path efficiency alone.
Performance approaching the random-walk reference instead indicates weaker question-conditioned navigation.
blocks.zh:
结构校准. 表2报告了一发导航性能以及结构校准参考。
无偏倚的随机行走代表了无向导的曲面,而最短路径的oracle则被赋予了有效的答案集,而不是附加说明的推理路径,并选择一个最短路径到一个答案.
因此,神谕并不是一条对路径忠诚的束缚,因为通往有效答案的最短路径不一定与问题暗示的推理路径相吻合。
编辑距离小,重叠分数比甲骨文高的模型遵循附加说明的推理结构比单从答案知识和最短路径效率上实现的更紧密.
相反,接近随机行走参考的性能表明问题条件导航较弱。

blocks.en:
One-Shot Navigation Performance. Across the evaluated SLMs, terminal-answer accuracy and path fidelity vary substantially despite broadly similar deployment scales.
On Kinship , Ministral 3 achieves the highest Hits@1, whereas Gemma 4 achieves the strongest path fidelity across the reported metrics.
This shows that endpoint accuracy and path fidelity can favor different models.
On both MQuAKE-ST settings, however, Ministral 3 achieves the strongest performance on both answer accuracy and path fidelity.
Qwen3 and Gemma 4 form the next strongest group.
Several of the stronger SLMs also outperform the shortest-path oracle on the path-fidelity metrics, indicating closer agreement with the annotated reference reasoning structure than an answer-informed shortest route through the graph.
By contrast, weaker models move toward the structural calibration references, indicating less effective question-conditioned navigation.
Calls/Q should likewise be interpreted relative to the reference path length k ¯ \bar{k} rather than minimized independently, since low values can reflect premature stopping.
blocks.zh:
单热导航性能. 在整个评估的可持续土地管理中,最终答案准确度和路径忠诚度差异很大,尽管部署规模大致相似。
Gemma 4在所报的衡量标准上实现了最强的忠诚度。
这表明端点精确度和路径忠诚度可以偏向不同的模型.
然而,在MQuAKE-ST两种设置上,Ministry 3在答题准确度和路径忠诚度上都取得了最强的表现.
Qune3和Gemma 4组成了下一个最强的组.
一些较强的可持续土地管理也超过了路径-真实性衡量标准上最短的路径,表明与附加说明的参考推理结构更接近于通过图表提供答案的最短路径。
相比之下,较弱的模型转向结构校准参考,表明问题条件导航效果较差.
与参考路径长度 k\ bar{k} 相比, 调用/ Q 也应予以解释, 而不是独立最小化, 因为低值可以反映过早停止 。

blocks.en:
Effect of One-Shot Demonstration. Table 3 compares zero-shot and one-shot navigation under the same evaluation interface.
The effect of a single demonstrated trajectory is strongly model dependent rather than uniformly beneficial.
Gemma 4, Ministral 3, and Qwen3 generally improve both terminal-answer accuracy and path fidelity under one-shot prompting, whereas Granite 3.3 degrades under the same intervention and OLMo-3 also weakens in several settings.
Other models exhibit mixed behavior.
In particular, Llama 3.1 can improve terminal-answer accuracy without a corresponding improvement in PED, showing that prompting can affect endpoint success and path agreement differently.
Changes in Calls/Q are similarly heterogeneous, with some models producing stronger trajectories using fewer calls and others requiring additional calls after the demonstration.
Overall, a single trajectory demonstration can affect terminal-answer accuracy, path fidelity, and stopping behavior differently across models.
blocks.zh:
一热示威的效果。 表3比较了同一评价界面下的零射和一射导航.
单一显示的轨迹的效果在很大程度上取决于模型,而不是一致有益。
Gemma 4, Ministry 3和Qwen3在一发提示下普遍提高终端答题准确度和路径忠诚度,而Granite 3.3在同一干预下降解,OLMo-3在多个场合也减弱.
其他模型表现出混合行为.
特别是,Llama 3.1可以在PED没有相应改进的情况下提高终端解答的准确性,表明提示会不同地影响端点的成功和路径协议.
呼叫/Q的变化也各不相同,有些模型使用较少的呼叫产生较强的轨迹,另一些模型则需要在演示后增加呼叫。
总体而言,一个单一的轨迹演示可以影响终端答案的准确性,路径忠贞性,并不同模型不同地停止行为.

blocks.en:
Effect of Explicit Search. Table 4 evaluates whether adding ToG-style search changes the behavior observed under local navigation.
Relative to Table 2 , the w = 1 w=1 setting yields lower Hits@1 and higher PED for all three models, despite requiring more LLM calls.
Notably, Ministral 3 and Gemma 4, which are among the strongest models in the isolated navigation setting, degrade substantially under the search scaffold, while Qwen3 remains comparatively stronger.
Increasing the width to w = 3 w=3 further decreases Hits@1 and worsens PED across all models.
Generated-answer accuracy nevertheless exceeds terminal Hits@1 in every setting, showing that answer synthesis can recover correct answers from imperfect search trajectories.
Overall, under this matched directed setting, additional ToG-style search does not improve trajectory fidelity, and increasing search width provides no consistent benefit in generated-answer accuracy.
Because the scaffold jointly introduces prompting, relation and entity selection, path pruning, sufficiency checking, and answer generation, these results further motivate evaluating such components individually rather than attributing system-level behavior to search alone.
blocks.zh:
明确搜索的效果。 表4评价添加 ToG 样式搜索是否改变在本地导航下观察到的行为.
相对于表2, W = 1 w = 1 的设置为所有三种型号产生较低的Hits@1和更高的PED,尽管需要更多的LLM调用.
值得注意的是,3号和Gemma 4号部位是孤立导航环境中最强的模型之一,在搜索脚手架下大幅降解,而Quen3号则仍然相对强大.
将宽度提高到 w = 3 w = 3 进一步降低Hits@1,并使所有模型的PED恶化.
尽管如此,生成的答题精度在每个设置中都超过了终端Hits@1,表明答题合成可以从不完善的搜索轨迹中恢复正确的答案.
总体而言,在这种匹配的定向设置下,额外的ToG式搜索并不能提高轨迹的忠诚度,而增加搜索宽度并不能对生成答案的准确性产生一致的好处.
由于脚手架联合引入了提示,关系和实体选择,路径推算,充分性检查和答案生成,这些结果进一步激励了对这些组件的单独评价,而不是将系统层面的行为单独归结为搜索.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We evaluated frozen, off-the-shelf Small Language Models (SLM) as local graph-navigation policies under a controlled setting that fixes graph access, restricts execution to presented legal graph actions, and uses the terminal entity as the predicted answer.
Across Kinship and MQuAKE-ST , similarly sized models exhibit substantial differences in both terminal-answer accuracy and path fidelity.
Endpoint accuracy and path fidelity can rank models differently, as observed on Kinship , while the strongest model on MQuAKE-ST performs well on both criteria.
A single trajectory demonstration can also improve or degrade these measures depending on the model.
A complementary ToG-style evaluation shows that adding a multi-stage search-and-generation scaffold does not necessarily preserve the strong local-navigation behavior observed in isolation, while generated answers can partially mask trajectory failures.
These findings motivate component-wise evaluation of relation and entity selection, search control, stopping, and answer synthesis, as well as future study of task-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了冰冻的、现成的小型语言模型(SLM)作为本地的图导航政策,在一个可控的设定下,它修正了图表访问,将执行限制为呈现法律图表动作,并以终端实体作为预测的答案。
在Kinship和MQuAKE-ST之间,类似大小的模型在终端答案准确度和路径忠诚度方面都显示出很大的差异。
端点精确度和路径忠贞度可以对模型进行不同的排序,如在Kinship上观察到的,而MQuAKE-ST上最强的模型在两个标准上都表现良好.
单一的轨迹演示也可根据模型改进或降解这些措施。
一个互补的ToG风格评价显示,添加一个多阶段的搜索和生成脚手架并不一定能保留隔离中观察到的强大的局部导航行为,而生成的答案可以部分掩盖轨迹故障.
这些结论激励着对关系和实体选择、搜索控制、停止和回答综合以及未来针对具体任务的适应性研究进行成份评价。
